entities.name: Lonis
entities.description: Simic snake elf scout, detective and cryptozoologist from Ravnica who searches for hidden creatures.

entities.name: Winnoram
entities.description: Fabled creature Lonis believes the genetic fragments belong to.

entities.name: Risen Undercity
entities.description: Place where Lonis found fragments of unknown genetic material.

events.summary: Lonis discovers fragments of never-before-seen genetic material in the Risen Undercity and devotes himself to studying them as possibly belonging to the winnoram.
events.quote: the discovery of fragments of never-before-seen genetic material found on an exploration into the Risen Undercity

relations.note: Lonis is a Simic snake elf.
